name: Rubinstein Minimum-Degree Class
definition: For each d at least 10, this is the class V_d on d+2 coordinates from Corollary 44 of Rubinstein--Bartlett--Rubinstein. Its bitwise complement is the union of three sets: S1 has four free coordinates, then the fixed word 00110011, then d-10 zero coordinates; S2 has fixed 0011, then four free coordinates, then fixed 1100, then d-10 zero coordinates; S3 has fixed 11001100, then d-6 free coordinates.
